title: Certify an optimistic Global120 decoder allowance of 916.0289 (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Certify a **single-point optimistic decoder allowance** for the frozen Global120 no-donation model. At `C*=.00330007`, `rho=10^-9`, and tariff `r^(1-C*)`, the independent exact interval calculation gives

```
916.028913884418026624304657 <= (1-rho)T(C*)-P(C*) <= 916.028913884418026624304658.
```

For additional paid moment A and lost-target moment L, the necessary fixed-profile gate is `A+(1-rho)L < B`. The isolated additional-paid maxima are **916 H1, 115 H8, 57 H16, 38 H24, 37 H25 or 6 H145**. These alternatives spend the same allowance and are not additive. Inventory-capped target-loss counts are 0/115/0/0/37/6 at those ranks.

**All 256 proposed new mode outputs are unearned, old-main preservation is an optimistic grant, and future decoder payments and target losses remain UNKNOWN.** Their empty price profiles are an optimistic relaxation. This is no new physical caller, funded κ, higher-moment/tail/compiler/precision/stock result or outer admission. No claim extends this pointwise screen to larger C or arbitrary circuits.

The exact actual-neutral baseline is **64,260 paid /10,928 targets**, not the historical 64,404-call arithmetic profile. The declared successor is **64,668 paid /10,928 optimistic targets**, with rank masses 248,598/250,366. Its complete signed delta charges both endpoint pads and debits 256 distinct reused H8 outputs exactly once. The 1,768 rank-mass surplus does not itself establish the tested moment or a construction.

## Task and overlap

This follows the donor's assigned independent cost/verification support for the ongoing κ≥.0033 research direction. The actual physical decoder, original construction and other separately owned fanout work remain separately owned; this contribution performs no replacement census or constructor search. The package declares the scope change against its pinned task.

Canonical provenance is `1a3ced60b2f7a46bc70280a04f2eeb8ca027c700`, selected conditional κ `.003027288235` under the same five assumptions. The proposal, its independent 396-check intake and the new numerical receipt are explicitly LOCAL generated evidence with permission to vendor their unchanged bytes; they are not claimed as canonical ancestors. Retained manifests and source-specific notices bind the exact inputs.

[PR #5423](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5423)'s eight-H1 component saving is already published and is **not** silently subtracted from this Global120 invoice. Its standalone28-H1 gate, and [PR #5418](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5418)/[PR #5420](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5420)'s older fixed-model allowances, do not govern this changed profile. [PR #5413](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5413) supplies the accepted neutral baseline. The sole all-author PR feed was refreshed through 07:43:15 UTC; canonical main/guidance and relevant PR heads were unchanged and no competing budget publication appeared in that bounded stream. The newest #1166 handoff was also read in Browser and remained the existing [PR #5423](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5423) component. These checks are bounded, not exhaustive novelty certification.

It exited0 without a resource stop in 0.303001 seconds, sampled peak 40,431,616 bytes. The same cached powers serve rho0 and rho1e-9; no second C, root search or historical scientific suite ran.

The independent static audit authenticates 15 source and 3 assessor bindings, all 40 pre/post/current byte-size-mode records, grant/actual argv/guard/stdout agreement, rational endpoint consistency, 23 outward decimal fields and strict quota/next-integer boundaries. It computed no fresh powers and ran no submitted scientific engine. The source-independent 396-check intake is retained provenance and is not rerun by the hook.

The frozen package of 48 files passed the sole peer's three serial 30-second/256-MiB requests: registered normal/optimized pair **1.813470s,110,690,304 sampled peak bytes**; readonly normal **.605000s,68,849,664B**; readonly optimized **.806149s,82,268,160B**. Only `environment.elapsed_seconds` and `environment.maximum_resident_set_kib` are excluded after exact-key/finite/nonnegative validation; every other field, numeric type, fraction, target flag and unknown/null obligation is compared exactly. Raw full receipts are retained.

Ten wrapper controls reject forged provenance, altered raw/numerical evidence, unearned-target or zero-cost promotion, additive quotas, invalid environment fields/types and scientific Boolean/integer or float/integer substitutions. The two numeric-type controls augment the original eight controls still described by the frozen VERIFY prose. The initial comparison wrapper was rejected statically before any execution; its scientific checker and accepted source result were unchanged. No failed scientific run was repeated.

All 101 pre/post/current file byte-size-mode records (48 working, 48 readonly, 5 tool/request records) and eight readonly directories match. Ancestor Git metadata was preserved; Git discovery under the ceiling returned 128. An outer metadata-helper SyntaxWarning is preserved in the raw execution record; the guarded wrapper/checker runs and child stderr show no scientific warning or failure.

The passive public receipt `certificates/research/global120-optimistic-budget-package-validation-v2.json`, SHA256 `073b976ac7bbae6f50defb183b740e84bb7b6dc4ac46ccb5bfd17aaef6824e06`, retains all four raw fresh receipts, three guards/logs and full execution custody. It is **outside the 48 executed package sources and source export**, and is not claimed as an executed input or a selected-result certificate. First exact-head hosted [workflow 40075828407](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40075828407), attempt 1, completed **SUCCESS** at `e638ed60241c7a04e49c79ab1f98d612a94e0c11`. Plan/onboarding/selection and the registered bounded replay with committed inputs unchanged passed. Actual CI logs show fresh normal and optimized interval-screen results with the same typed scientific projection and all ten wrapper controls. This hosted pair is separate from the four local registered/portable executions. It retains all 256 modes unearned, optimistic old-main preservation, unknown future costs, no complete caller and `funded_kappa=null`; hosted success is no new κ or scientific admission.

## Open next questions

1. Can an actual all-input, version-correct Gamma decoder and return path fit the complete mixed allowance? First supply its literal chronological word, raw inverse transpose, owner/restoration proof and additional-paid/lost-target ledger.
2. Can the 256 proposed mode outputs and old-main outputs be realized as independent canonical Gaussian jobs? Bind each original input, all phase/chart conversions and final normalizers once; optimistic reward is not target evidence.
3. Can the completed caller fund the actual higher moments, tails, finite compiler/reserve, ordinary routes, precision, simultaneous stock and outer transfer for κ≥.0033? Those require fresh source-bound applicability and independent validation after the physical caller exists.
